reach_defacto.label: Food-supported reach v2.1 · v2 with enclosed land as territory

items.label: Hatched: unadministered upland / forest inside a polity (scenario)
Light tint and fine line: painted claim, not held

reach_defacto.note: Control v2, with every pocket wholly enclosed by one polity's held land as its territory: 68 % of land held, 2.5 % unadministered upland or forest (pockets steeper, more forested or emptier than the polity's held land); desert or empty pockets (0.3 % of land; median P/PET < 0.2 or < 0.5 people/km2) stay holes. Earth tests (calibration/geography_control_20261107/plan_A.json): development Rome AD 150 + Han AD 2; blind Song China AD 1080 0.737 and the late-antique Mediterranean AD 550 0.774, against 0.697 and 0.766 for v2. Borders are drawn as lines over the relief; patches under 3 cells are merged. See reports/GEOGRAPHY_CONTROL_PLAN_20261107.md.
reach_defacto.caption: Fill: the polity whose staffed towns and kept roads are nearest (year-round days <= 2), plus the land it wholly encloses. Hatching: enclosed but ungoverned. Light tint: your painted claim where it is not held. Dark lines: borders of held territory.

reach_defacto.label: Food-supported reach v2 · joint budget + the roads staffed towns keep

items.label: Not held: no staffed town or kept road within 2 year-round days

reach_defacto.note: Held where the nearest polity's staffed towns (joint food budget: 1039 of 1072 sites) or the painted roads within 2 year-round days of them are within 2 days over the year. 65 % of land held. Earth tests: Rome AD 150 (development) 0.835 against 0.820 for transport only; blind on Chinese county seats, Western Jin AD 280 0.707 against 0.710 and Ming AD 1580 0.787 against 0.789, with 98-99 % of seats fed. See reports/EARTH_CONTROL_20261106.md.
reach_defacto.caption: Hue: the polity whose staffed towns and kept roads are nearest (year-round days <= 2). Food decides which towns are staffed; extent rule from the Earth tests.
